card.name: Section number after Warnings and Precautions
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or the space just before the section number in a cross-reference such as [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3)]. It appears in drug label cross-references to the Warnings and Precautions section.

modes.label: Opening parenthesis
modes.description: The "(" right after "Warnings and Precautions" in a bracketed cross-reference.
modes.example: [see Dosage and Administration (2.2) , Warnings and Precautions<< (>>5.2) ] .

modes.label: Space before number
modes.description: The blank space inside the parentheses, just before the section number 5.x.

card.writes: It suppresses "info" and "information" words and promotes unrelated tokens, so there is no clear effect beyond expecting a number next.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a section number like 5.3 is about to be written in a label cross-reference.
